concerns.text: Task T009 is tagged `[P2]` (parallel‑safe) but it overwrites `data/results/ks_results.json` in place. Since T010 also modifies the same file, running T009 in parallel with T010 (or any other task that reads the file) would cause a race condition and data loss. The `[P]` tag is therefore inaccurate; these tasks should not be marked parallel‑safe.

Task T010 is also tagged `[P2]` yet it updates `ks_results.json` (the same artifact modified by T009). This shared mutable output makes the task unsafe for parallel execution, contradicting the `[P]` designation.

Task T006 expects a file `sim_catalog.csv` as input, but when the download in T004 succeeds the pipeline produces `data/raw/simulation_catalog_raw.csv` and no subsequent task converts it to `sim_catalog.csv`. Consequently, if the download succeeds, T006 will lack its required simulation input, violating the producer‑before‑consumer ordering. A conversion task (e.g., `process_downloaded_simulation.py`) is needed to generate `sim_catalog.csv` from the raw download before T006 runs.
